title: favorite-words
epigraph:
“In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.” — John 1:1
“There took shape in the heart, there took shape on the tongue the form of Atum. For the very great one is Ptah, who gave [life] to all the gods and their kas through this heart and through this tongue, in which Horus had taken shape as Ptah, in which Thoth had taken shape as Ptah.” — the Shabaka Stone, c. 710 BC (trans. Miriam Lichtheim)
